1] They are heard and perused the case diary.

2] This is the applicant's III bail application filed under Section 483 of B.N.S.S./ 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, as he / she is implicated in connection with Crime No.81/2024 registered at Police Station Cyber Cell, Zone Indore, District Indore (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 34, 467, 468, 471, 201 and 120B of IPC read with Section 66D of Information Technology Act,
2000.

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 10.6.2024.
His second bail application was dismissed as withdrawn by this Court vide order dated 9.9.2025 passed in MCRC.No.33335/2025.

3] Allegation against the present applicant is that he was involved in the present case wherein on 16/2/2024 the complainant Dheeraj Jaiswal, has filed a written complaint regarding the fraudcommitted with him of RS 85,21,000/- through a share tradingapp on WhatsApp.

During the investigation police have arrested the present applicant with other co- accused, alleging that the applicant has helped the other co-accused to open current and saving account in bank, in which they have committed theforged transaction from different mobile numbers.

NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:318 2 MCRC-59010-2025 4] Counsel for the applicant, at the outset, has submitted that similarly situated co-accused Hitesh Jain has already been granted bail by this Court in M.Cr.C. No.48506 of 2025 dated 11.11.2025, and the case of the present applicant is identical to that of co-accused Hitesh Jain.

sentences.text: applicant is lodged in jail since 10.6.2024 and the conclusion of trial will take sufficienty long time,
thus, it is prayed that on the ground of parity, present application be also allowed.
5] Counsel for the State has opposed the prayer, however, it is not denied that co-accused Hitesh Jain has already been granted bail.
6] On due consideration of submissions and on perusal of the case-diary as also the order passed in M.Cr.C. No.48506/2025, this Court is inclined to allow the present application.
7] Accordingly, maintaining parity, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is hereby allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
8] Accordingly, the application is allowed and disposed of.
C.c. as per rules.
